targets.name: Sony PlayStation 3
boot_chain: legacy OtherOS on specifically compatible firmware/models
OtherOS++ with Petitboot on specifically compatible configurations
targets.graphics: PS3 framebuffer; accelerated RSX access is not assumed
targets.desktop_goal: XFCE4 experimental; lightweight desktop fallback required
targets.notes: A real Linux port exists and a recent external Debian project documents a PS3-specific 6.4 kernel path. This is a research target, not a Snakey-supported release. Boot compatibility is model- and firmware-dependent.
